description: This file implements a network flow algorithm (Dinic's algorithm) for computing maximum flow and minimum cut in a graph, including classes and methods for graph construction, flow augmentation, residual graph analysis, and cut partitioning.

classes.name: DinicFlowGraph
classes.description: A class implementing Dinic's max flow algorithm with methods for residual graph construction, flow augmentation, and min cut computation.

methods.name: add_flow
methods.description: Adds flow to an edge and updates its reverse edge accordingly.

methods.name: reverse_edge
methods.description: Returns the reverse edge of a given edge.

methods.name: residual_level_graph
methods.description: Constructs the residual level graph using BFS for level assignment.

methods.name: augment_iteration
methods.description: Performs one iteration of flow augmentation using DFS on the level graph.

methods.name: compute_max_flow
methods.description: Computes the maximum flow between source and sink nodes.

methods.name: reverse_bfs_reachable
methods.description: Finds vertices reachable from t in the reverse residual graph.

methods.name: partition
methods.description: Partitions vertices into reachable and unreachable sets based on residual graph reachability.

methods.name: minimum_cut
methods.description: Computes the minimum cut between two nodes using max flow and residual graph analysis.
